name: operator+(std::reverse_iterator)

declarations.code:
template <class Iter>

reverse_iterator<Iter> operator+

    (typename reverse_iterator<Iter>::difference_type n,

        const reverse_iterator<Iter> &it);

intro: Returns the iterator it incremented by n. In fact, the underlying iterator is decremented by n.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 the number of positions to increment the iterator


 it

 -

 the iterator adaptor to increment
